question.text: The maximum number of possible oxidation states of actinoids are shown by:

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math> show maximum number of oxidation states starting from <math><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></math> to <math><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></math> all oxidation states.
